lines.zh: 我拖着长吻在沙上探路。
lines.en: I drag my long snout along the sand to feel the way.

lines.zh: 我看起来慢，吻却伸得很远。
lines.en: I look slow, but my snout reaches far.

lines.zh: 我粉白的皮在暗水里发灰。
lines.en: My pink hide turns grey in the dark water.

lines.zh: 我游过海沟，吻端轻轻扫。
lines.en: I cross the trench, snout sweeping lightly.
I do not chase fast fish; I wait for slow ones.

lines.zh: 我的身体软，转弯却利落。
lines.en: My body is soft, yet I turn neatly.

lines.zh: 我用长吻拨开一层海草。
lines.en: I part the seagrass with my long snout.

lines.zh: 我贴着坡面往上，慢慢来。
lines.en: I work up the slope, slowly.

lines.zh: 暗处有动静，我先探吻过去。
lines.en: Something stirs; I send my snout ahead.

lines.zh: 我这条哥布林鲨，长得怪。
lines.en: I am a goblin shark, and I look strange.
My snout stands out more than my body.

lines.zh: 我顺着海底的沟槽滑行。
lines.en: I glide along the grooves of the seabed.

lines.zh: 水压变浅了，我有点不习惯。
lines.en: The pressure lightens and I am uneasy.
I close in slowly and startle nothing.

lines.zh: 我把长吻伸进岩缝里探了探。
lines.en: I push my long snout into the rock crevice.

lines.zh: 上方有光，我压着身体游过去。
lines.en: Light above; I swim across low and flat.

lines.zh: 我摆尾很轻，怕惊了沙里的东西。
lines.en: I beat my tail softly, lest I startle the sand.

lines.zh: 水流变急，我贴着坡面慢慢挪。
lines.en: The current quickens; I creep along the slope.

lines.zh: 我停在水里，吻端还在动。
lines.en: I hover, snout still feeling about.

lines.zh: 深海没有光，粉皮也没用。
lines.en: There is no light here for pink skin.

lines.zh: 我把下颌收着，省点力气。
lines.en: I keep my jaw stowed to save strength.

lines.zh: 我的长吻碰到石头，停了一下。
lines.en: My snout meets stone and pauses.

lines.zh: 我在等一条游得慢的鱼。
lines.en: I am waiting for a slow-swimming fish.
Nobody in this trench is in a hurry.

lines.zh: 我身体绷得很松，像块软肉。
lines.en: My body hangs loose like soft flesh.

lines.zh: 我偶尔张一下嘴，又收回去。
lines.en: Now and then I open my mouth and stow it.

lines.zh: 洋流推我，我懒得顶回去。
lines.en: The current pushes; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我在数头顶游过的影子。
lines.en: I count the shadows passing overhead.
The pores on my snout are hunting a scent.
Slow as I am, I have not starved.

lines.zh: 海底的沙很细，我陷了半寸。
lines.en: The sand is fine and I sink half an inch.
I am waiting for the dark to deepen.

lines.zh: 我抬起长吻，对着你的脸。
lines.en: I lift my long snout toward your face.
You stand so upright; I rarely see that.
I turn slowly, snout arriving first.
Your hand is much larger than any fish.
I stare, jaw still stowed.

lines.zh: 你停下，我的下颌也缩回去。
lines.en: You stop, and my jaw slides back in.

lines.zh: 我想知道你的皮好不好咬。
lines.en: I wonder if your hide bites well.

lines.zh: 你身上有金属味，我不熟。
lines.en: You smell of metal, which I do not know.
I bring my snout close, then pull back.

lines.zh: 我的长吻伸出，碰了碰你的影。
lines.en: My long snout juts out and touches your shadow.
My soft flesh contracts and I sink.
The blow knocks my snout aside.
My blood blooms in the dark water.
It hurts enough to stow my jaw.
I roll over and slowly right myself.
So slow, I cannot even flee.
Not the snout; it is very sensitive.
I back off half a meter and stop.
A white line opens on my pink hide.

lines.zh: 你身上那股铁味，我记住了。
lines.en: That iron smell on you, I will remember it.

lines.zh: 那块肉的味道，我吻端先知道。
lines.en: My snout tastes that meat before I do.

lines.zh: 你晃的东西，我慢慢靠过去。
lines.en: I drift slowly toward what you dangle.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，下颌已经探出来了。
lines.en: I open up and my jaw already reaches out.
Easy; I cannot swim fast, wait for me.

lines.zh: 这味道让我从沟底上来了。
lines.en: This smell brought me up from the trench floor.
My pink hide pulls taut.

lines.zh: 你给的比我自己找的好。
lines.en: What you offer beats what I find.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的手，吻端直点。
lines.en: I circle your hand, snout tapping.
Lower it a little and I can reach.
I cannot swallow it whole, so I bite first.

lines.zh: 我软软地撞上你，弹开了。
lines.en: I bump you softly and drift off.

lines.zh: 我的长吻撞到你的护腿。
lines.en: My long snout knocks your leggings.
One move from you shoves me aside.

lines.zh: 我贴着你转，避开你的脚。
lines.en: I press past you, clear of your feet.

lines.zh: 我身体太软，撞了也不疼。
lines.en: I am too soft for the bump to hurt.
My long snout can probe the seabed.
You squeeze me against the reef.

lines.zh: 我吻端折了一下，又弹回。
lines.en: My snout bends and springs back.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，水都浑了。
lines.en: We collide and the water goes cloudy.

lines.zh: 我退开，慢慢绕到另一边。
lines.en: I withdraw and slowly go around.

lines.zh: 同类来了，我把下颌收好。
lines.en: My kind arrives and I stow my jaw.

lines.zh: 我们并排悬在水里，很慢。
lines.en: We hang side by side, very slowly.
Its snout is a little shorter than mine.
We touch snouts, one to the other.

lines.zh: 深海里找个伴，得靠味道。
lines.en: In the deep, a partner is found by scent.
It circles me, pink hide brightening.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后，往沟上走。
lines.en: We head up the trench, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 谁也不伸下颌，这是规矩。
lines.en: Neither extends a jaw; that is the rule.
It leaves and I do not follow.
Our kind is scarce in these parts.

lines.zh: 我咬住那块沉的肉，往下坠。
lines.en: I bite the heavy meat and sink with it.

lines.zh: 我的牙细，抓东西不太稳。
lines.en: My teeth are fine and grip poorly.
Whatever falls, I guard slowly.
I cradle it in my extended jaw.
This will not give; I go for softer.
Carrying it, my snout tilts.

lines.zh: 沙里半埋的东西，我也要。
lines.en: Even half-buried things in the sand are mine.
I am not greedy; one mouthful is enough.

lines.zh: 它滑出去了，我又咬回来。
lines.en: It slips out and I take it again.

lines.zh: 有东西沉下来，我慢慢过去。
lines.en: Something sinks; I drift over slowly.
That fish swims slow; I choose it.
I smell blood and the direction is set.
It is slower than I am. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我把吻端对准它的尾巴。
lines.en: I point my snout at its tail.

lines.zh: 大东西我咬不动，挑小的。
lines.en: Big things I cannot bite; I pick small.
It hides in a crevice and I wait.
In this trench, it is the nearest.
I fix on its flank.

lines.zh: 它往深处沉，我跟着往下。
lines.en: It sinks deeper, and I follow down.
Target chosen; I close in slowly.
I hang above it, snout angled down.

lines.zh: 深海里没有灯，只有我的吻。
lines.en: No light down here. Only my snout.

lines.zh: 我把下颌收着，等最后一刻。
lines.en: I keep my jaw stowed until the last moment.
Its shadow covers me, which is perfect.
I measure the gap: one meter, then half.

lines.zh: 它好像察觉了，停了一下。
lines.en: It seems to notice and pauses.

lines.zh: 我这张嘴能突然伸出去。
lines.en: My jaw shoots out without warning.
My snout is a fist away from it.
I still the water and keep silent.
Now, and my mouth opens.
My jaw shoots out and clamps.
My fine teeth pierce and I pull back.
The bite is faster than my swimming.
It struggles twice and I hold.

lines.zh: 我把下颌收回来，带着肉。
lines.en: I retract my jaw with the meat.
Slow is mine, and fast is mine too.
Your leg now has two rows of fine holes.
I bite once and swim off.
That took all the strength I have.
Do not underestimate this slow shark.

lines.zh: 我从深沟里升上来，水是黑的。
lines.en: I rise from the deep trench into black water.
My snout was long when I was born.

lines.zh: 这片主世界的海，我能待。
lines.en: This overworld sea will do for me.

lines.zh: 生成表里给我留了位置。
lines.en: The spawn table kept a place for me.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋把我放在这片沙上。
lines.en: A spawn egg set me on this sand.

lines.zh: 我第一次看见这么浅的水。
lines.en: First time I have seen water this shallow.
The trench is crowded; I move on.
I sink slowly, looking for a rock.
New place, and the scent is unfamiliar.
I decide to wait here for nightfall.
Hot water turns my pink hide white.
I land snout-first on the sand.

lines.zh: 我拼命吸水，却什么也没进。
lines.en: I gulp and nothing enters.
The blast sends me far.
An arrow plants itself in my back.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的下颌锁住了。
lines.en: That magic locks my jaw shut.
Hunger makes even my snout tremble.
Lightning enters the water and I seize up.
Below there is no echo at all.
